# Amiga News — Apollo schedule and later licensing report

- Original title: Apollo team: Release Schedule and project information; July 2026 follow-up
- Source: [Original publication](https://www.amiga-news.de/en/news/AN-2025-11-00033-EN.html)
- Author / publisher: Apollo Vampire Lair press release; later reporting by cg, Amiga News
- Language / date: English; 2025-11-07 and 2026-07-23
- Access: Press-release text inspected through indexed passages; complete later report inspected in the news archive.
- Checked: 2026-09-09

The November release statement says a publisher contact change delayed licensing discussions and moves the intended release from December 2025 to the first quarter of 2026. This was a forecast, not evidence of release.

A [23 July 2026 follow-up](https://amiga-news.de/en/standard/?frm_perPage=21&frm_start=42) reports distribution of demos through paid membership. According to the journalist, Willem Drijver confirmed there was no distribution license, and Microids representative Maxime Geraci also denied a license and knowledge of the described project. These are attributed reports, not an independent legal determination. The follow-up archive is paginated and may shift; its individual article link failed to load.
